answer: The network validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 unique service slots, enforcing that each agent occupies a dedicated slice of infrastructure. A verifier issues a rhythmic signal to each reserved slot, measuring the round-trip interval to confirm occupancy within a tight latency prism. If the measured response dips toward a performance nadir, the verifier flags the slot for potential sharing and triggers an immediate audit. Honest participants pay 1x cost, whereas an attacker must pay 1,000x for isolated slots.
